Theme B — Poolside プールサイド
balanced · recommended

Overview

Hiroshi Nagai's pool — at dusk in dark mode, at noon in light. Deep sky navy and lit water against a coral sun; or pale sky, white concrete and deep aqua. This family carries five of the eight city pop characteristics, including the gradient skies and cool/warm/highlight accent structure that most define Nagai's covers.

Palette

Cool primary, warm secondary, high-attention tertiary. Every value is checked against both the page and the card background; the figure shown is the lower of the two.

Typography

Outfit for headings with 0.06em tracking, Inter for body, IBM Plex Mono for data. Scale ratio 1.250. Smaller headings go uppercase — the sleeve lettering register.
